sentences.text:
He filed the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
 (i) issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction commanding the first respondent to issue Good Conduct Certificate/Police Clearance Certificate to the petitioner without mentioning the pendency of CC 299/2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is apparent from the facts and circumstances of the case that CC No.299/2022, a case relating to the commission of offence under Sections 323 and 498A of IPC, is pending trial before the learned Magistrate.

That being so, there is absolutely no justification in seeking the relief that the 1st respondent should be directed to issue a Good Conduct Certificate/Police Clearance Certificate without mentioning the pendency of the said case.
The present petition is apparently unfounded.

opennyai_summary.facts: The petitioner is the accused in CC No.299/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court I, Chengannur.
opennyai_summary.decision:
He filed the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
 (i) issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction commanding the first respondent to issue Good Conduct Certificate/Police Clearance Certificate to the petitioner without mentioning the pendency of CC 299/2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Chengannur.
The present petition is apparently unfounded.
Dismissed accordingly.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
2. It is apparent from the facts and circumstances of the case that CC No.299/2022, a case relating to the commission of offence under Sections 323 and 498A of IPC, is pending trial before the learned Magistrate.
That being so, there is absolutely no justification in seeking the relief that the 1st respondent should be directed to issue a Good Conduct Certificate/Police Clearance Certificate without mentioning the pendency of the said case.
